scope: Functional readability and final-page layout, not source pixel comparison or human accessibility/accounting approval.
observations: Report shows multiple statuses, ascending sort, full-result subtotal and CSV action within the shell.
Invoice final pages retain repeated identity, brought-forward amount, one final totals/payment/terms block and Page n / total.
ERP2 maximum result font wraps the title and uses a separate summary page without clipping or overlapping the footer.
